name: Aoki Toshio
source:
[url=/c92501]Gonbee[/url]'s direct boss. Single.
Following the transfer notice, Aoki takes him to the Material Department to meet [url=/c92502]Sayaka.[/url]
[spoiler]Later on in the story, the true purpose of this transfer is revealed to alleviate Sayaka's workaholic personality, since it results in her being alienated from other colleagues in the company.[/spoiler]
